appearances.whereabouts: Fleeing uphill from Aginor; then on a hilltop confronting Aginor; transported to a mountain pass battlefield; climbs steps through nothingness; enters Ba'alzamon's chamber
appearances.notable_actions: Flees from Aginor up a steep hill to a cliff edge; battles Aginor for control of the glowing power cord; inadvertently destroys Draghkar with lightning, creates a wall of fire and earthquake that devastates the Trolloc army; climbs mystical steps; confronts Ba'alzamon in his chamber; creates a blade of Light; frees his mother's soul from torture; severs Ba'alzamon's black cord; destroys Ba'alzamon with Light
appearances.demeanor: Initially terrified and desperate; becomes filled with Light and calm within the void; determined and resolute when confronting Ba'alzamon; struggles with doubt but maintains control

appearances.whereabouts: Pursuing Rand up the hillside to a clifftop
appearances.notable_actions: Pursues Rand up a steep slope effortlessly; speaks of bringing Rand to Shayol Ghul for Ba'alzamon's rewards but decides to take power for himself; battles Rand for control of the power source; grows stronger and more fleshed as he draws on the cord; is destroyed when flame shoots from his mouth and eyes
appearances.demeanor: Confident and arrogant; greedy for power; becomes desperate as Rand contests him for the power source
alliances_shown: serves Ba'alzamon but plots to betray him

appearances.whereabouts: In a chamber with melted walls, polished table, and fireplace of tortured faces
appearances.notable_actions: Confronts Rand in his chamber; claims to have orchestrated all events in Rand's life; attempts to manipulate Rand into kneeling to him; creates illusions of Egwene, Nynaeve, and Rand's mother; tortures the image of Kari al'Thor with Fades; shies back from Rand's blade of Light; screams when his black cord is severed; is destroyed by Light from Rand's sword
appearances.demeanor: Initially confident and mocking; becomes fearful when Rand wields the Light; screams in agony as he is destroyed
alliances_shown: claims to control the Black Ajah

relationships.description: Aginor pursues Rand with intent to capture or kill him for Ba'alzamon's reward; they battle for control of the power source
Aginor serves Ba'alzamon but considers betraying him to seize power for himself
Ba'alzamon seeks to enslave or destroy Rand; claims to have orchestrated Rand's entire life; Rand ultimately destroys him
Kari is Rand's mother; appears as a manifestation claiming to be enslaved by Ba'alzamon and tortured; Rand frees her soul
Aginor claims to have faced Lews Therin in the Hall of the Servants and fought him stroke for stroke in the past
Ba'alzamon claims to manipulate the Amyrlin Seat, making her dance while she thinks she controls events
